lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Reports of more Kaiju incoming to Kaiju City! Protect the Peninsula!!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: It's your job to protect this city, so do it!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The punk from the station finished re-education. Mentally compliant. Physically, stronger than he should be. The mohawk stays, apparently.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The punk from the station won't be a problem anymore. Cold, but clean.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sonar is showing a second wave off the coast. Bigger than the first.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Get back to the Peninsula. Hold the line!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Another wave down. You two are holding this city together.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: They are coming faster than they used to.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Keep it up. I'm seeing good numbers on your {power} power.

choices.text: Where are they all coming from?

reply.speaker: agent
reply.text: That's above your pay grade. For now.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: There have been reports of Kaiju body parts falling onto rooftops in the Cemetary district. Go investigate and try not to let another citizen touch them!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The woman from the rooftop cemetery is through re-education. She still hears voices, so: stable, for her. Physically flawless. We could not get her out of the black.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The woman from the rooftop cemetery is in the ground. Fitting, for that address.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: No time to rest. The shipping lanes just went dark.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Oh no...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: It's the biggest group yet... But the Peninsula will not fall today!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The harbor is quiet again. The Mayor sends his thanks.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Quiet never lasts around here.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: No, it doesn't. Keep that {power} power charged.

choices.text: Is anyone looking into all these Kaiju parts?

reply.speaker: agent
reply.text: Yeah, we got our best guys on it. You will meet them soon enough...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Something has happened at the Aquarium. Go.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The mermaid is in re-education. Mental state: she is a mermaid. Physically, she's scaling nicely. The tail is a lot.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The mermaid is off the board. The Aquarium wants to know who's paying for the repairs...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: All units, all units: Kaiju on every approach.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: This is everything they have. Hold the Peninsula, whatever it takes!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Soldier, report to the lab, on the double. The brains have been cooking-up something special for you.

rapidTransit.intro.label: Subway: Punk Guy finds the eye

lines.speaker: Punk Guy
lines.text: Ooo... pretty...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: No, don't touch it!

rooftop.intro.label: Rooftop: Punk Girl at the graves

lines.speaker: Punk Girl
lines.text: Is someone there? I can hear them...

lines.speaker: Punk Girl
lines.text: It's my ancestors... they're calling to me from the graves.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Step away from that!

lines.speaker: Punk Girl
lines.text: They're so ANGRY. They want me to take it!

aquarium.intro.label: Aquarium: the worker and the tongue

lines.speaker: Aquarium Worker
lines.text: I'M A MERMAID!!

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: She must've worked here... but the Kaiju radiation is scrambling her brains, like the others.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Ma'am, put that down!

aquarium.stopScream.label: Aquarium: brought to zero, her scream shatters the glass

lines.speaker: Aquarium Worker
lines.text: Stop!!!

lines.speaker: Punk Girl
lines.text: I can feel their power flowing through me!

rooftop.ghostScream.label: Rooftop: brought to zero, before her scream

lines.speaker: Punk Girl
lines.text: Protect me, ancestors!

lines.speaker: recruit
lines.text: Jumping into the sewers was quick thinking.

lines.speaker: recruit
lines.text: That swanky Agent will never look for us down here.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Our powers are gone.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: The Lab only ever lent them to us, using nano-tech.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Powers gained by touching Kaiju parts...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: That is how the bystanders we fought got theirs: by touching the fallen Kaiju parts.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: And that's why the Agent's ray didn't take yours.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Those are different... Those powers last.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: If we can find some Kaiju parts and touch them...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: We could get our powers back, and fight back.

lines.speaker: recruit
lines.text: What's that glow?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Are those... Kaiju parts?

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: The one thing we need, and it was in the next room this whole time.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: That is crazy.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: They must be specimens from the Lab.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Flushed down the pipes when the brains finished their morbid experiments.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: And now they are all we have left.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: There's no taking this back. Whatever it does to us, it lasts.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: I never said it, but... I'm glad it was you out there with me.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: OK... let's do this.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Let's do this.

street.greeting.label: Street: the Agent calls the team over

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hey, soldiers! Over here.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Good work out there. You beat them back.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Careful around those Kaiju parts. They are hazardous.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: One touch, and a person is changed for good.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Word from West Rapid Transit: Bystanders are gathering.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Get there before someone touches one.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Oh, and if you need to: stop by the Lab on your way.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: They can give you a boost of Kaiju Juice,

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: or change out your teammate.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Go.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Welcome to the Lab.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Have a look around.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: *nervous* Oh, those?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Nothing to worry about...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Just some R&D. Cryo-chimeric epigenetics.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: You came back here? With no powers?

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: We found the parts you flushed. We touched them. We got our powers back.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Ha... ha ha...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: HA HA HA HA HA HA HA!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: What's so funny?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Powers from Kaiju parts are inherently unstable, soldier.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: All these Kaiju... Where did you think they were coming from?

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Every one of them used to be an Agent.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Failed experiments.

lab.transformation.label: Lab fight: after the clones, the teammate transforms

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Something's wrong... my hands... they're burning.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hey. Hey, look at me. Breathe.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Get away from me! I can't... hold it...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: No... no, no, no.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: You did well, soldier.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: But those powers were only on loan.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: And we have no more need for you. Meet the new team.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Clones... That's what was in the tanks!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Lab property. We are taking them back.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Our powers... they are gone!

lines.speaker: recruit
lines.text: Not mine. I still have mine. Kaiju powers are not theirs to take.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Seize them!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Get them! Don't let them escape!

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Run! Get to the exit, now!

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: The others will hold them off! Run for the exit!

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Not much to do here...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...but it could be a good place to train.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Heads-up, teammate. They're coming!

recruit.choice.label: Every recruit choice: the teammate over the bystander

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: I guess we're going to {last} {him}, like the others?

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Recruit {him}, and the crew grows by one...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...or study {his} DNA and take {his} power. That would be fatal for {him}.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: I guess we're going to terminate {him}, like the others?

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: There's no crew to grow... it's just been the two of us.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: We could recruit {him}, and start one... or take {his} power, and it would be fatal for {him}.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: We have recruited, and we have terminated...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Recruit {him}, and we gain a crew member...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...or terminate {him}, and harvest {his} power.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Another one... The last one joined the crew.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: We could recruit {him} too, and grow the team...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...or study {his} DNA and take {his} power. That would be fatal for {him}.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Last time, we took the power for ourselves.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: We could study {his} DNA again, and take {his} power. It would be fatal for {him}...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...or we could recruit {him} onto the crew.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Maybe we could recruit {him}...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...or we could study {his} DNA to get {his} power.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Though that would be fatal for {him}.

lines.speaker: Lab Tech
lines.text: Looking good!

finalBattle.intro.label: Final battle: the giant at the foot of the Peninsula

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Your partner has reached critical mass, soldier. It's headed for the city.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: That's not a Kaiju. That's my partner.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hold on. I'm bringing you back.

finalBattle.voices.label: Final battle: the teammate's voice, from inside the Kaiju, as each wave comes

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: I can hear you... I can't stop walking...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: They're coming for you... because of me...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Keep going... it's working... I can feel it fading...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: This is going to hurt. Hold still.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...Did I... hurt anyone?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You're back. That's all that matters.
